DeleteCloudDataBody: This removes your sessions from the cloud and turns Auto sync off on this device. Your sessions stay on this device. Other devices on the same Chrome profile will upload their copy again the next time they sync, unless Auto sync is off there too.
MergeKeepsOne: Merge keeps the session on this device and adds any sessions from the backup that aren’t already here.
MergeKeepsOther: Merge keeps the {{count}} sessions on this device and adds any sessions from the backup that aren’t already here.
ReplaceDeletesOne: Replace deletes the session on this device and on every device that syncs with it, then loads the backup. This can’t be undone.
ReplaceDeletesOther: Replace deletes the {{count}} sessions on this device and on every device that syncs with it, then loads the backup. This can’t be undone.

ExistingSyncBody: Tab Keeper syncs your saved sessions so you can open them on your other Chrome devices. Synced sessions include tab addresses and titles. They are stored under a random ID — not your name or email.
Would you like to keep sync on for this: Would you like to keep sync on for this device?
ExistingSyncOff: If you turn it off, future changes stay on this device. Sessions already in the cloud remain until you delete them in Settings → Sync & backup. You can change this anytime there.
EnableSyncBody: Tab Keeper can keep a copy of your saved sessions — the addresses and titles of the tabs in them — in the cloud, so your other Chrome devices can open them too.
EnableSyncFine: Stored under an anonymous ID, no account or email. You can turn it off, or delete the copy, in Settings → Sync & backup.

Your sessions stay on this device. Turn: Your sessions stay on this device. Turn on Auto sync, or press the cloud button on the home screen, to start syncing.
EnableSyncOnceFine: This syncs once. Auto sync stays off until you turn it on in Settings → Sync & backup. Stored under an anonymous ID, no account or email.
